title: Skilled For Service
verse: He made the sacred anointing oil and the pure fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
observation: In today’s chapter, we see how God is continuing to use Bezalel and his team to build the tabernacle and all the instruments of worship. The Bible says that they were skilled in various techniques to make what was needed for worship. Where do you think they learned how to do all these things? It is likely they learned how to do all this while still in slavery. This is a great lesson for all of us. God has given us all gifts, talents, and skills. We learn these skills throughout life in various ways. We should never think that our training is no good if we did not learn it in the house of God. There will be many seasons where God will train us in many ways using various means. The goal is to use these gathered skills and see them as a vehicle to serve the Lord. When we do, we realize that God has gifted all of us and trained all of us to make a difference.
application: What do you know how to do that you can turn into a vehicle to serve others?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for preparing us to make a difference.
